propos: Everything is a multiple of 4. Each measurement is drawn here at its real size, not merely written.
cadre-note: The frame height is drawn as a length: 800 px do not fit on a screen. The strip scrolls on its own; the page never does.
composants-note: Each square carries the measurement on both sides, even when the token only applies to a width or a height.

propos-groupe.espacements: A grid of 4. Seven spacings, and nothing in between.
propos-groupe.cibles: 48 px minimum for anything that is touched; 56 px for a settings, checkbox or radio row.
propos-groupe.rayons: Three radii only: the direction is square.
propos-groupe.filets: A rule states the separation, its thickness states the importance. The focus ring is 3 px, set 2 px away from the target.
propos-groupe.zones: What the status bar, the tab bar and the system gesture take from the screen.
propos-groupe.cadre: Reference frame 360 × 800, checked at 390 × 844. Nothing has a fixed width except the time column.
propos-groupe.composants: The dimensions a component does not choose for itself.
